main_text.l: Argilla est terra pinguis & lenta, è qua fiunt figulina vasa.

Terra sigillata vel Lemnia, est portio terræ valdè rubens, in Infula Lemno effossa, & Dianæ sacerdotis sigillo obsignata. Effoditur hodie etiam in Silesia & Hafsia terra Lemnia non deterior: Venenis resistit. Scal. exerc.93.&33.sect.2.
Terra Armenica est portio terræ in Armenia effossa, colore pallido, egregiè siccans.
CAPUT XIII. DE ORYCTICA CHYMICA seu DE METALLIS ET METALLICIS, ex doctrina & experientia Chymicorum.

Metallum est corpus minerale vi virtutis metallorum seminariæ in terræ chalchantosæ minera è mercuriali succo sulphureoq; spiritu, caloris digerētis vehiculo constitutū, & in substantiâ fusile, malleoq; extensilem conformatum.

page.notes: The initial letter of "Oryctice" is a woodcut ornament; the first letter (O) is only partly visible, so it is marked [?]. The right margin contains a small decorative mark beside "Oryctica Chymica", not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page is present in the background and omitted. Printed spellings kept as they appear (Infula, Hafsia, feminariæ read as seminariæ, chalchantosæ, digerētis, constitutū).
